nodes.name: chords.ts
nodes.summary: Static chord-progression presets written as Roman numerals, plus the tier-gated combat blessing (gold/silver/bronze) each progression earns.

nodes.name: encounters.ts
nodes.summary: Curated multi-enemy encounter templates of escalating difficulty, with helpers for lookup, validation, unlock gating, and linear progression.

nodes.name: enemies.ts
nodes.summary: Static enemy profiles and instrument balance data: HP, gauge periods, attack cadence, parry motif tuning, weaknesses, resists, and special behaviours.

nodes.name: roster.ts
nodes.summary: Named character roster with per-fighter stats, instrument, element, role, and lore for the playable party.

nodes.name: chordEffectFor
nodes.summary: Derives a tier-gated ChordEffect (loop regen, ward, bonus damage, and a flavour label) from a progression's theory score.

nodes.name: getEncounter
nodes.summary: Looks up an encounter definition by id.

nodes.name: validateEncounters
nodes.summary: Verifies every encounter lists at least one enemy and that all referenced enemies exist.

nodes.name: isEncounterUnlocked
nodes.summary: Gates an encounter behind the previous one being cleared in the linear chain.

nodes.name: getNextEncounterId
nodes.summary: Returns the next encounter id in linear order, or null at the end of the chain.

nodes.name: getCharacter
nodes.summary: Looks up a roster character definition by id.

nodes.name: combat.ts
nodes.summary: Core deterministic combat engine: builds fights, advances the 16th-note tick, and resolves melody and parry QTE damage, potency, buffs, and win/loss without touching audio or React.

nodes.name: keys.ts
nodes.summary: Musical key helpers for fights: the key pool, case-insensitive key comparison and labels, and deterministic key selection.

nodes.name: parryChart.ts
nodes.summary: Deterministic parry-chart generator: turns player melodies and enemy pattern motifs into antecedent/consequent note cells, then emits timed lanes, holds, and chord degrees.

nodes.name: perform.ts
nodes.summary: Timing and cursor helpers shared by the perform/parry layers: parry key detection, cursor movement across degree and octave, and BPM-to-steps conversions.

nodes.name: refreshPotency
nodes.summary: Resets melody potency for every onset key when the arrangement's onset set changes.

nodes.name: reconcilePotency
nodes.summary: Drops potency entries whose onsets are no longer present in the arrangement.

nodes.name: createFight
nodes.summary: Builds the initial fight state from party and enemy selections: fighters, gauges, cooldowns, melody potency, lane slots, and the key locked for the whole fight.

nodes.name: aliveParty
nodes.summary: Returns the party members that are not downed.

nodes.name: aliveEnemies
nodes.summary: Returns the enemies that are not downed.

nodes.name: moveFighter
nodes.summary: Moves a fighter between front lanes and the deck, updating slot assignment and logging the move.

nodes.name: qteLocked
nodes.summary: Reports whether an active chord or preset QTE is currently blocking new QTE requests.

nodes.name: melodyMuted
nodes.summary: Reports whether the melody layer is muted for the current tick.

nodes.name: requestChordQte
nodes.summary: Builds a chord-based QTE chart from a Roman progression (falling back to a random chart) sized to the loop window.

nodes.name: requestPresetQte
nodes.summary: Builds a QTE chart from the player's saved melody snapshot or preset rows, sized to the loop window.

nodes.name: pressQteKey
nodes.summary: Routes a key press into active QTE note matching.

nodes.name: releaseQteKey
nodes.summary: Routes a key release into active QTE hold-note resolution.

nodes.name: cancelQte
nodes.summary: Cancels the active QTE and logs the reason.

nodes.name: keeperInstrument
nodes.summary: Returns the instrument of the front performer acting as timekeeper, or undefined if none is alive.

nodes.name: hasLiveAttacker
nodes.summary: Checks whether any front-lane attacker is still standing.

nodes.name: defaultPerformerId
nodes.summary: Picks the default performer (front-slot holder) for melody actions.

nodes.name: laneAttacker
nodes.summary: Returns the live attacker occupying a given lane within a fighter list.

nodes.name: performSlot
nodes.summary: Maps a performer's party index to the lane they are currently performing from.

nodes.name: computeNoteDamage
nodes.summary: Computes a single melody onset's damage: evasion roll, crit, enemy weakness/resist multipliers, and incoming-damage buffs.

nodes.name: resolveMelodyVoice
nodes.summary: Resolves one melody voice for the current step: picks a target lane, applies damage or healing, applies chord effects and buffs, and detects win/loss.

nodes.name: advanceTick
nodes.summary: Advances the fight one 16th-note tick: chord effects, gauges, enemy attacks, QTE lifecycle, buff ticking, melody resolution, and win/loss checks.

nodes.name: keyEquals
nodes.summary: Case-insensitive comparison of two musical keys by tonic and scale.

nodes.name: keyLabel
nodes.summary: Human-readable label for a key, such as 'C major'.

nodes.name: randomFightKey
nodes.summary: Picks a random fight key from the key pool using the injected rng.

nodes.name: resolveFightKey
nodes.summary: Resolves the key to lock for a fight, honouring an explicit override or a seeded random pick.

nodes.name: laneToParryKey
nodes.summary: Clamps a lane index to the parry key that represents it.

nodes.name: parryKeyToLane
nodes.summary: Maps a parry key back to its lane index.

nodes.name: degreeToParryLane
nodes.summary: Maps a scale degree onto the parry lane that visually represents it.

nodes.name: parryParamsFor
nodes.summary: Merges a pattern's default parry motif parameters with per-enemy overrides.

nodes.name: romanRoot
nodes.summary: Extracts the uppercased Roman-numeral root from a chord label, ignoring quality suffixes.

nodes.name: laneToChordDegree
nodes.summary: Maps a parry lane to the scale degree that stays in-chord for the current Roman numeral.

nodes.name: chordPool
nodes.summary: Builds the chord tones (as degrees) available for a Roman numeral under a key.

nodes.name: extractPlayerCell
nodes.summary: Extracts up to four player onsets from melody tracks as a parry cell of lane/slot notes.

nodes.name: buildAntecedentCell
nodes.summary: Builds the antecedent half of a parry phrase from the player's cell, a contour, and a slot template.

nodes.name: developConsequentCell
nodes.summary: Develops the consequent half of a parry phrase from the antecedent via reflection, inversion, or variation.

nodes.name: generateParryChart
nodes.summary: Generates a complete deterministic parry chart: slots, lanes, holds, and chord degrees timed to the loop window.

nodes.name: isParryKey
nodes.summary: Checks whether a key is one of the parry keys.

nodes.name: moveCursor
nodes.summary: Moves the note cursor in response to a key event, respecting degree and octave bounds.

nodes.name: cursorDegree
nodes.summary: Converts the cursor position into an absolute scale degree.

nodes.name: pressToLen
nodes.summary: Converts a key-hold duration in milliseconds into a note length in steps.

nodes.name: stepMs
nodes.summary: Returns the duration of one 16th-note step in milliseconds for a given BPM.

nodes.name: secondsToSteps
nodes.summary: Converts seconds into whole 16th-note steps for a given BPM.

nodes.name: stepsToMs
nodes.summary: Converts a step count into milliseconds for a given BPM.

nodes.name: qte.ts
nodes.summary: Self-contained QTE model: key/degree mapping, chart builders (melody, harmonic, pattern, random), press/release judging with ratings, and parry damage maths.

nodes.name: theory.ts
nodes.summary: Vendored zero-dependency music-theory core: pitch-class/degree/MIDI conversion, Roman-numeral chord parsing, and progression scoring for voice leading, diatonic fit, and syntax.
nodes.languageNotes: Vendored in place of Tonal.js because every published tonal release ships a broken main entry; absolute note names stay confined to this module (and the audio boundary).

nodes.name: units.ts
nodes.summary: Fighter unit model: construction, shield-aware damage, healing, buff application and ticking, and buff display glyphs, all as pure state logic.

nodes.name: degreeToPerformKey
nodes.summary: Maps a scale degree to the keyboard key that performs it.

nodes.name: keyToDegree
nodes.summary: Maps a performance key back to its scale degree and octave.

nodes.name: qteKeyToDegree
nodes.summary: Resolves a QTE chart key label into a scale degree for note construction.

nodes.name: ratingWeight
nodes.summary: Returns the numeric weight of a QTE judgement rating.

nodes.name: chartFromMelody
nodes.summary: Builds a QTE chart from the player's melody tracks, capped to a maximum note count.

nodes.name: harmonicChart
nodes.summary: Builds a QTE chart from a progression of Roman numerals.

nodes.name: patternMotif
nodes.summary: Returns the note motif registered for a named enemy or preset pattern.

nodes.name: fitChartToWindow
nodes.summary: Rescales and clamps a chart's note offsets so it fits the ticks available in the current window.

nodes.name: chartKeys
nodes.summary: Lists the distinct keys a chart uses.

nodes.name: chartFromPattern
nodes.summary: Builds a QTE chart from a named pattern motif and a target length.

nodes.name: randomChart
nodes.summary: Generates a deterministic random chart of a given length from the injected rng.

nodes.name: synthChartFromSequence
nodes.summary: Synthesises a chart from a sequence of note onsets between start and deadline ticks.

nodes.name: createQte
nodes.summary: Creates the QTE state object (notes, keys, deadlines, started tick) from a chart or note sequence.

nodes.name: pressQte
nodes.summary: Judges a key press against pending QTE notes: hits, near-misses, early presses, and hold starts.

nodes.name: releaseQte
nodes.summary: Judges a key release against active hold notes and closes each note with a rating.

nodes.name: missOverdueNotes
nodes.summary: Marks notes whose timing window has passed as missed and updates the QTE score.

nodes.name: isQteComplete
nodes.summary: Reports whether every note in a QTE has been resolved.

nodes.name: isQteExpired
nodes.summary: Reports whether a QTE is complete or past its deadline tick.

nodes.name: qteSuccessRate
nodes.summary: Computes the weighted success rate of a completed QTE from its note ratings.

nodes.name: parryDamage
nodes.summary: Applies the QTE outcome to parry damage: full damage on success, chip fraction on failure.

nodes.name: normalizePitchClass
nodes.summary: Normalises a pitch-class string (accidentals, casing) to a canonical sharp name.

nodes.name: pitchClassOfMidi
nodes.summary: Returns the pitch class of a MIDI note number.

nodes.name: midiToNote
nodes.summary: Converts a MIDI note number to an audio-layer note name.

nodes.name: degreeToMidi
nodes.summary: Converts a scale degree in a key and octave to a MIDI note number.

nodes.name: romanToChord
nodes.summary: Converts a Roman numeral to its chord's MIDI notes, raising the third of V in minor keys.

nodes.name: romanFunction
nodes.summary: Classifies a Roman numeral as tonic, dominant, or predominant for syntax scoring.

nodes.name: voiceLeadingScore
nodes.summary: Scores a chord progression by how smoothly its voices move between chords.

nodes.name: diatonicFitScore
nodes.summary: Scores how well a progression's tones sit inside the key's scale.

nodes.name: syntaxScore
nodes.summary: Scores a Roman progression's functional syntax such as cadences, dominants, and resolutions.

nodes.name: scoreProgression
nodes.summary: Combines voice-leading, diatonic-fit, and syntax scores into a total with a gold/silver/bronze tier.

nodes.name: tensionOf
nodes.summary: Measures the dissonance between a melody note and the current chord.

nodes.name: makeFighter
nodes.summary: Constructs a fighter unit from an init descriptor, deriving shields and combat stats.

nodes.name: isDown
nodes.summary: Reports whether a fighter is downed at zero HP.

nodes.name: damageThroughShield
nodes.summary: Applies damage to a fighter, consuming shield first and returning the damage outcome.

nodes.name: healFighter
nodes.summary: Heals a fighter, clamped to max HP and reviving a downed fighter.

nodes.name: addShield
nodes.summary: Adds shield to a fighter, clamped to its maximum.

nodes.name: applyBuff
nodes.summary: Applies or refreshes a buff on a fighter, stacking duration where appropriate.

nodes.name: tickBuffs
nodes.summary: Advances a fighter's buffs by one tick, emitting expiry and heal events and dropping expired buffs.

nodes.name: buffGlyphs
nodes.summary: Renders a compact glyph string for a fighter's active buffs.

nodes.name: buffDamageTaken
nodes.summary: Returns the damage-taken multiplier contributed by a fighter's buffs.

nodes.name: arrangement.ts
nodes.summary: Loop arrangement model: music as relative, serializable data. Melody onsets live in per-attacker-slot tracks as NoteEvents and chords as Roman numerals, with absolute MIDI resolved only at the audio boundary by snapshotStep.

nodes.name: createDefaultArrangement
nodes.summary: Builds the starter 4-bar C-minor loop at 90bpm: i-VI progression, a seeded two-bar motif on slot 0 and the default rig.

nodes.name: toggleNoteEvent
nodes.summary: Returns a new arrangement with one attacker-track step set to the given NoteEvent (or cleared), validating slot/bar/step bounds and degree/length.

nodes.name: clearTracks
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the arrangement with every attacker melody track wiped; used by track-wipe enemies.

nodes.name: countOnsets
nodes.summary: Counts melody onsets across all attacker slots, feeding preset cooldown scaling and log lines.

nodes.name: setGroove
nodes.summary: Equips a groove onto the arrangement, storing a deep clone so callers cannot mutate the source rig.

nodes.name: withMelody
nodes.summary: Swaps in a melody card's tracks (defensively copied) and fits its chord progression to the current bar count.

nodes.name: tweakGrooveKnobs
nodes.summary: Applies swing-knob edits to the arrangement's equipped groove.

nodes.name: setBarChord
nodes.summary: Replaces the Roman numeral of a single bar, bounds-checking the bar index.

nodes.name: fitProgression
nodes.summary: Repeats or truncates a Roman-numeral progression to exactly `bars` entries, defaulting to i when empty.

nodes.name: setChords
nodes.summary: Replaces the whole chord progression, rejecting empty input and cycling it to fit the loop length.

nodes.name: setBpm
nodes.summary: Sets tempo, clamping to 50-160 bpm and rounding to an integer.

nodes.name: setKey
nodes.summary: Sets the arrangement key, storing a copy so the caller's Key object cannot be mutated.

nodes.name: snapshotStep
nodes.summary: Resolves one bar/step to absolute MIDI - chord tones, melody voices with chord-tone flags, bass, per-voice drum hits, kit id and swing delay - the only place scale degrees become pitches.

nodes.name: loopLength
nodes.summary: Returns the loop length in steps (bars x stepsPerBar).

nodes.name: locateStep
nodes.summary: Maps a global step counter to a {bar, step} pair, wrapping negative and overflowing indices back into the loop.

nodes.name: hashMelodySet
nodes.summary: Hashes a melody set plus progression into a stable 8-char hex key over sorted onset tuples, so renames, slot no-ops and delete/recreate all dedupe to the same preset.

nodes.name: onsetKey
nodes.summary: Builds the canonical `slot:bar:step:degree:len` identity string for one melody onset, shared by preset dedup and potency tracking.

nodes.name: onsetKeysOf
nodes.summary: Flattens every non-null melody onset of a track grid into its canonical onset key.

nodes.name: allOnsetKeys
nodes.summary: Returns the canonical keys of every onset currently on the loop.

nodes.name: groove.ts
nodes.summary: Drum rig model: banks of 4x4 clips (4 voices x 4 complexity tiers), rigs that pick one clip per voice, kits that own timbre plus the combat effect, swing feel, bottling and legacy-aware persistence parsing.

nodes.name: parsePattern
nodes.summary: Parses a 16-character notation string (X/x/g/r/R/-) into a clip's hit array, throwing on bad length or unknown glyphs.

nodes.name: formatPattern
nodes.summary: Renders a clip's steps back to the readable 16-character notation, round-tripping parsePattern.

nodes.name: emptySteps
nodes.summary: Creates a 16-slot all-rest clip step array.

nodes.name: emptyCell
nodes.summary: Creates a four-voice groove cell with every column resting.

nodes.name: cloneCell
nodes.summary: Deep-copies a groove cell so hit objects are never shared between rigs.

nodes.name: cloneGroove
nodes.summary: Deep-copies a rig including picks, effect and the resolved cell.

nodes.name: clampTier
nodes.summary: Coerces an arbitrary number into a valid clip tier 0-3, defaulting to 0 for non-finite input.

nodes.name: clampSwing
nodes.summary: Clamps swing into 0..MAX_SWING (0.6), rounded to two decimals.

nodes.name: resolveCell
nodes.summary: Copies each picked clip from a bank into its voice's 16-step column; a bank missing a clip leaves that column silent instead of throwing.

nodes.name: createRig
nodes.summary: Builds a rig from a bank, per-voice picks, a kit and an optional identity seed: clamps tiers, resolves the cell and adopts the bank's swing feel.

nodes.name: applyKit
nodes.summary: Swaps a rig's drum kit - timbre id and the denormalized combat effect - without touching its pattern.

nodes.name: withPick
nodes.summary: Swaps one voice's clip tier from a bank and marks the rig as hand-built (custom).

nodes.name: withBank
nodes.summary: Switches a rig to another bank page, adopting that bank's default pads, feel and identity while bottled rigs keep their id.

nodes.name: tweakGroove
nodes.summary: Applies knob edits (swing) to a rig, clamping out-of-range values instead of throwing.

nodes.name: grooveHitVel
nodes.summary: Returns the hit velocity at a step, 0 for rests and out-of-range steps.

nodes.name: grooveHit
nodes.summary: True when the rig sounds the given voice on the given step.

nodes.name: grooveHitRoll
nodes.summary: Returns the number of extra 32nd-note sub-hits scheduled inside a step.

nodes.name: countGrooveHits
nodes.summary: Counts the hits the rig will actually sound across one bar.

nodes.name: isSilent
nodes.summary: True when every drum column of the rig rests.

nodes.name: swingDelaySteps
nodes.summary: Swing lag for one step in 16th-step units - half the swing value on odd steps, 0 on even - so the feel holds at any bpm.

nodes.name: describeGrooveEffect
nodes.summary: Renders a rig's combat effect (cadence, crit bonus, parry window) into a short human-readable line for cards and the battle meter.

nodes.name: bottleGroove
nodes.summary: Compose-to-bottle: names the current rig, gives it a unique bottle id and hands it back as a recallable bottle card.

nodes.name: isHit
nodes.summary: Type guard validating that a persisted step value carries a 0..1 velocity and an optional roll of 0/1/2.

nodes.name: parseSteps
nodes.summary: Validates and normalises a persisted 16-slot step array, returning null when malformed.

nodes.name: parsePicks
nodes.summary: Reads persisted per-voice tier picks, defaulting each unknown voice to tier 0.

nodes.name: parseEffect
nodes.summary: Reads a persisted groove effect, falling back to the neutral value per field for missing or non-finite entries.

nodes.name: parseGroove
nodes.summary: Parses a persisted rig from either the v2 cell format or the legacy hit-offset format, returning null for anything malformed so old saves degrade instead of crashing.

nodes.name: loadout.ts
nodes.summary: Card loadout model: the ids of the groove and melody cards a player brings into a fight, with caps, copy-on-write auto-selection and pruning against the live banks.

nodes.name: createDefaultLoadout
nodes.summary: Builds the starting card bag: the default rig plus the default melody card.

nodes.name: toggleLoadoutId
nodes.summary: Adds or removes a card id from a bag, respecting the max cap and the one-card floor.

nodes.name: selectLoadoutId
nodes.summary: Auto-selects a card, dropping the previous one first when the bag is full; used by the copy-on-write fork path.

nodes.name: sanitizeLoadout
nodes.summary: Prunes ids that no longer resolve against the live card banks, falling back to the default card so a bag is never empty.

nodes.name: parseLoadout
nodes.summary: Parses a persisted loadout, keeping only string ids and returning null when either list is malformed.

nodes.name: melodyBank.ts
nodes.summary: Melody card bank: preset and player-authored [slot][bar][step] loop + chord snapshots, the three starter cards, and clone/save/update/delete helpers.

nodes.name: isPresetMelodyCard
nodes.summary: True when an id belongs to one of the three shipped preset melody cards.

nodes.name: cloneTracks
nodes.summary: Deep-copies a [slot][bar][step] track grid so note events are never shared.

nodes.name: cloneTemplate
nodes.summary: Deep-copies a melody template including tracks, chords and tags.

nodes.name: listMelodyCards
nodes.summary: Returns every card in the bank as a defensive copy.

nodes.name: createDawnAnthem
nodes.summary: Authors the Dawn Anthem starter card: a balanced strings-plus-piano motif over i-VI, mirrored to fill a 4-bar loop.

nodes.name: createStaccatoFlight
nodes.summary: Authors the Staccato Flight starter card: rapid 16th-note stabs aimed at evasive horde enemies, over i-iv.

nodes.name: createSolemnGround
nodes.summary: Authors the Solemn Ground starter card: long sustained lines with brass punctuation for high-armor tanks, over i-V.

nodes.name: createDefaultMelodyBank
nodes.summary: Builds the starter bank of three preset cards (Dawn Anthem, Staccato Flight, Solemn Ground) keyed by id.

nodes.name: saveTemplate
nodes.summary: Snapshots tracks plus chords into a named card, generating an id when needed and labelling preset ids as preset while everything else becomes custom.

nodes.name: updateTemplate
nodes.summary: Overwrites a custom card's tracks and chords in place, a no-op for unknown ids.

nodes.name: deleteTemplate
nodes.summary: Removes a card from the bank, returning the bank unchanged for unknown ids.

nodes.name: getTemplate
nodes.summary: Looks up a melody card by id.

nodes.name: phase.ts
nodes.summary: Game state machine: the menu -> prep <-> studio -> combat -> victory/defeat phases, with guards and the table of valid transitions.

nodes.name: isGamePhase
nodes.summary: Type guard testing a value against the known game phases.

nodes.name: isCombatActive
nodes.summary: True when the current phase is combat.

nodes.name: canFreelyEditArrangement
nodes.summary: True in menu, prep or studio - the phases where the arrangement can be edited without disturbing a live fight.

nodes.name: isValidTransition
nodes.summary: Checks a phase change against the VALID_TRANSITIONS table of the game state machine.

nodes.name: positions.ts
nodes.summary: Deck <-> position assignment: the chord slot holds the back row, attackers hold the front row, and deck membership is derived rather than stored so it cannot desync.

nodes.name: defaultSlots
nodes.summary: Assigns the party's first member to the chord slot and the next up-to-three to the front row.

nodes.name: deckIds
nodes.summary: Derives which party members sit in the deck (unassigned); membership is computed, never stored, so it cannot desync.

nodes.name: assignToSlot
nodes.summary: Moves a fighter into the chord or front slot, clearing any previous placement and keeping the front row at MAX_FRONT attackers.

nodes.name: removeToDeck
nodes.summary: Sends a fighter back to the deck by clearing them from every slot.

nodes.name: slotOf
nodes.summary: Reports which slot holds a fighter, or null when they are in the deck.

nodes.name: presets.ts
nodes.summary: Melody-set presets keyed by content hash with tick cooldowns: entries are tombstoned on delete so recreating an identical set cannot bypass its cooldown, and snapshots let a cooled preset be run back.

nodes.name: cooldownFor
nodes.summary: Cooldown in ticks for a melody set: two loops plus one tick per eight onsets.

nodes.name: savePreset
nodes.summary: Saves the current melody set under its content hash; an identical set - even renamed or previously deleted - shares the existing cooldown entry.

nodes.name: deletePreset
nodes.summary: Tombstones a preset by name so recreating the identical set still keeps its cooldown.

nodes.name: readyPresets
nodes.summary: Returns the live presets whose cooldown has elapsed.

nodes.name: isOnCooldown
nodes.summary: True when the arrangement's current melody set matches a preset that is still cooling down.

nodes.name: recallPreset
nodes.summary: Runs back a cooled-down preset snapshot, returning null when the hash is unknown, deleted or still cooling down.

nodes.name: resetPresetCooldowns
nodes.summary: Zeroes every non-deleted preset's cooldown, called when a fresh fight starts.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: Session singleton owning all engine state (arrangement, fight, banks, loadout, presets, phase) outside React, exposing getters, mutators and the subscribe() hook that the Zustand store mirrors.

nodes.name: getArrangement
nodes.summary: Returns the live arrangement; engine-owned, not a copy.

nodes.name: getFight
nodes.summary: Returns the current ATB fight state.

nodes.name: getMelodyMuted
nodes.summary: True while a chord swap mutes the soloist lanes; both the engine and the audio layer read it.

nodes.name: getPresets
nodes.summary: Returns the hash-keyed preset store.

nodes.name: getMelodyBank
nodes.summary: Returns the persistent melody card bank.

nodes.name: getGrooveChoices
nodes.summary: Every equippable rig: the curated presets followed by the bottled builds, all cloned.

nodes.name: getGrooveBottles
nodes.summary: Returns the Studio-built bottled rigs as defensive copies.

nodes.name: getGrooveById
nodes.summary: Resolves a rig id against the curated presets, then the bottled builds.

nodes.name: getBanks
nodes.summary: Returns the rhythmic archetype banks the drum matrix pages through.

nodes.name: getKits
nodes.summary: Returns every drum kit, each a free choice like the swing knob.

nodes.name: getPendingGroove
nodes.summary: Returns the rig queued for the next loop boundary, if any, as a clone.

nodes.name: getLoadout
nodes.summary: Returns the equipped card bag (1..4 grooves plus 1..6 melodies) as copies.

nodes.name: getMelodyCards
nodes.summary: Returns every melody card in the bank, presets first then custom.

nodes.name: getActiveMelodyCardId
nodes.summary: The card currently loaded in the grid, or null for an unsaved loop.

nodes.name: getPendingGrooveId
nodes.summary: Id of the rig queued for the next loop boundary.

nodes.name: getPendingMelodyId
nodes.summary: Id of the melody card queued for the next loop boundary.

nodes.name: toggleLoadoutGroove
nodes.summary: PREP: adds or removes a groove card from the bag, persists the choice and notifies listeners.

nodes.name: toggleLoadoutMelody
nodes.summary: PREP: adds or removes a melody card from the bag, persists the choice and notifies listeners.

nodes.name: equipGrooveNow
nodes.summary: Equips a groove immediately (PREP/STUDIO only) and persists the choice.

nodes.name: queueOrEquip
nodes.summary: Equips a rig at once outside combat, or queues it for the next loop boundary during combat so the pulse never breaks mid-phrase.

nodes.name: selectGrooveCard
nodes.summary: Picks a whole rig (preset or bottle): PREP equips it at once, combat queues it for the loop boundary.

nodes.name: selectPad
nodes.summary: Swaps one drum voice's clip tier on the rig under edit, then equips or queues the result.

nodes.name: selectBank
nodes.summary: Switches the drum matrix to another bank page, adopting its default pads, feel and a matching kit.

nodes.name: selectKit
nodes.summary: Changes the drum kit, swapping timbre and the denormalized combat effect together.

nodes.name: tweakEquippedGroove
nodes.summary: Applies swing-knob edits: in combat it queues the tweaked rig for the next loop boundary, otherwise it edits and persists immediately.

nodes.name: saveGrooveBottle
nodes.summary: Compose-to-bottle: saves the equipped rig under a name, equips it, bags it in the loadout and persists both.

nodes.name: deleteGrooveBottle
nodes.summary: Deletes a bottled rig, persists the bottle list and drops it from the bag unless it is the last groove card.

nodes.name: getGamePhase
nodes.summary: Returns the current game phase.

nodes.name: setGamePhase
nodes.summary: Sets the game phase and notifies listeners, a no-op when unchanged.

nodes.name: toMenu
nodes.summary: Transitions the game to the menu phase.

nodes.name: toPrep
nodes.summary: Transitions the game to the prep phase.

nodes.name: toStudio
nodes.summary: Transitions to the Studio step sequencer, which lives outside combat.

nodes.name: getEncounterId
nodes.summary: Returns the current encounter id.

nodes.name: setEncounterId
nodes.summary: Selects an encounter, refusing locked ones unless forced, and rebuilds the fight when in prep or menu.

nodes.name: getClearedEncounters
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the cleared-encounter id list.

nodes.name: isCurrentEncounterUnlocked
nodes.summary: True when progression has unlocked the given encounter.

nodes.name: unlockAllEncounters
nodes.summary: Marks every encounter cleared and persists the progression.

nodes.name: resetEncounterProgression
nodes.summary: Wipes progression: clears encounters, bottles and loadout, restores the default rig and erases persisted data.

nodes.name: getSelectedParty
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the selected party member ids.

nodes.name: setSelectedParty
nodes.summary: Sets the party line-up, persists it and rebuilds the fight when in prep or menu.

nodes.name: getCustomChordPresets
nodes.summary: Returns the player's custom chord progressions.

nodes.name: saveCustomChordPreset
nodes.summary: Saves a named chord progression (auto-naming blanks) and persists the custom chord list.

nodes.name: mutateArrangement
nodes.summary: Applies a caller-supplied arrangement transform and notifies listeners.

nodes.name: handleStep
nodes.summary: Per-clock-step driver: applies queued swaps at the loop boundary, advances the fight one tick, mirrors enemy track-wipes onto the arrangement and resolves victory or defeat.

nodes.name: moveFighter
nodes.summary: Moves a fighter between deck and slots, notifying listeners only when the fight actually changed.

nodes.name: beginFight
nodes.summary: Resets preset cooldowns, clears pending picks, locks the fight key onto the arrangement so grid and audio match, reconciles potency and enters combat.

nodes.name: startFight
nodes.summary: Starts or restarts a combat, rolling a random key unless one is supplied.

nodes.name: resetFight
nodes.summary: Restarts the current combat with fresh options, sharing beginFight's path.

nodes.name: getFrontPerformerId
nodes.summary: Returns the fighter at front-row position index (the 1/2/3 performer keys), or null when the slot is empty.

nodes.name: saveMelodyPreset
nodes.summary: Saves the live melody set as a named preset, sharing the cooldown of an identical set.

nodes.name: recallMelodyPreset
nodes.summary: Runs back a cooled-down preset at full strength, restoring its tracks and chords.

nodes.name: saveToMelodyBank
nodes.summary: Saves the current arrangement into the persistent melody card bank.

nodes.name: deleteMelodyCard
nodes.summary: Deletes a melody card, drops it from the bag (falling back to the first remaining card) and clears it as active.

nodes.name: saveCustomMelodyCard
nodes.summary: Snapshots the live loop as a new custom card, bags it, makes it active and persists the loadout - how a loop sung mid-combat survives the fight.

nodes.name: syncActiveMelodyCard
nodes.summary: Copy-on-write guard: forks a preset card into a custom (edit) card the moment the grid changes, else updates the custom card in place.

nodes.name: mutateMelody
nodes.summary: Arrangement edit that also keeps the active melody card in sync outside combat.

nodes.name: selectMelodyCard
nodes.summary: Loads a melody card into the grid: immediately in PREP, queued to the loop boundary in combat; rejects track-count mismatches.

nodes.name: loadMelodyTemplate
nodes.summary: Loads a template from the melody bank into the arrangement grid, delegating to selectMelodyCard.

nodes.name: applyPendingSwaps
nodes.summary: Applies queued mid-combat groove and melody picks at the loop boundary so a swap always starts on a downbeat.

nodes.name: requestTemplateChart
nodes.summary: Casts a melody-bank template mid-fight by opening a 16-tick QTE chart carrying its tracks and chords.

nodes.name: requestChordChart
nodes.summary: Opens a mid-fight 16-tick QTE chart carrying a new chord progression for a chord swap.

nodes.name: requestPresetChart
nodes.summary: Opens a mid-fight QTE chart carrying a cooled-down preset snapshot, refusing missing, deleted or cooling presets.

nodes.name: pressChartKey
nodes.summary: Scores a WASD press against an open song chart, ignoring parry charts.

nodes.name: pressParryKey
nodes.summary: Scores a ZXCV press against an open parry chart, holds included.

nodes.name: releaseParryKey
nodes.summary: Scores a ZXCV release against open parry holds, where releasing early counts as a miss.

nodes.name: scoreQtePress
nodes.summary: Shared QTE scoring helper: commits the new fight state and reports the rating only when it changed and is not a miss.

nodes.name: cancelChart
nodes.summary: Abandons the open QTE chart.

nodes.name: resetAll
nodes.summary: Full reset: default arrangement, empty bottles and presets, default melody bank and loadout, fresh fight, and the prep phase.

nodes.name: subscribe
nodes.summary: Registers an external listener and returns its unsubscribe function; the hook the Zustand mirror subscribes through.

nodes.name: context.ts
nodes.summary: Owns the browser AudioContext lifecycle and the master gain/limiter bus, started lazily and only on an explicit user gesture via ensureAudio().
nodes.languageNotes: Gesture-gated Tone.start() is required by browsers before any Web Audio node may sound.

nodes.name: perform.ts
nodes.summary: Live WASD audition through the active performer's own lead voice; no-ops until the pooled voices exist, and never records into the loop itself.

nodes.name: player.ts
nodes.summary: Tone.Transport bridge that schedules 16th-note steps from engine arrangement snapshots and renders drums, bass, melody lanes, and chord stabs without ever writing combat state.
nodes.languageNotes: Audio events fire inside the scheduled callback for sample accuracy while UI/combat updates are deferred through Tone.getDraw() to stay on the animation frame.

nodes.name: preview.ts
nodes.summary: One-loop audition player for cards and the loop sequencer, mutually exclusive across previews and restricted to the layers (drums/melody/all) that a card actually owns.

nodes.name: sfx.ts
nodes.summary: Atmospheric sound design and QTE/UI sound effects played through the pooled synths, each guarded against uninitialized audio and headless test environments.

nodes.name: synths.ts
nodes.summary: Pooled Tone.js voice factory: allocates every instrument's lead/pad/bass plus the shared drums and reverb exactly once after ensureAudio(), then exposes live kit recoloring and drum triggering for the step hot path.
nodes.languageNotes: Voices are allocated once and mutated via live parameter sets — never reallocated per note — for mobile Web Audio safety.

nodes.name: ensureAudio
nodes.summary: Boots the AudioContext on the first user gesture and builds the master gain -> limiter -> destination chain; idempotent after the first call.

nodes.name: getMaster
nodes.summary: Returns the master gain bus shared by all pooled voices, throwing if audio was never started.

nodes.name: auditionStart
nodes.summary: Starts a held audition note on the chosen instrument's lead voice, no-opping when the voice pool is not yet ready.

nodes.name: auditionBlip
nodes.summary: Fires a short non-destructive lead blip for QTE hits so a held audition note is never cut off.

nodes.name: auditionEnd
nodes.summary: Releases every instrument lead so a performer switch mid-hold cannot leave a note stuck, ignoring already-released voices.

nodes.name: configurePlayer
nodes.summary: Single wiring site that injects the arrangement, chord-voice, melody-voice providers and the step handler read by the live transport.

nodes.name: setBpm
nodes.summary: Clamps a requested tempo to the 50-160 BPM range and applies it to the Tone transport.

nodes.name: triggerAt
nodes.summary: Renders one step at a scheduled time: swings and fires the drum kit, then the chord keeper's bass, each melody lane's own lead, and the chord pad stab on step 0.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Ensures audio and pooled voices, schedules the 16th-note transport repeat, and routes combat/UI notifications through Tone's draw scheduler before starting the transport.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Clears the scheduled step and halts the transport, detaching the repeat even when already stopped so a preview cannot wake the live loop.

nodes.name: auditionStep
nodes.summary: Reduces a step snapshot to only the layers an audition owns: drums-only for a rig, melody-only (over silent drums) for a melody card, or the whole loop.

nodes.name: triggerPreviewAt
nodes.summary: Renders one preview step through the neutral strings voice: swung drums, bass, melody onsets, and the step-0 chord pad.

nodes.name: getPreviewId
nodes.summary: Returns the id of the currently sounding preview, or null when none is running.

nodes.name: stopPreview
nodes.summary: Silences the running preview, clearing its timeout and transport repeat, and bumps a generation counter so a superseded start abandons its await.

nodes.name: startPreview
nodes.summary: Plays an arrangement once from the top through the neutral voice, replacing any running preview and invoking onEnd when the loop finishes.

nodes.name: playVictoryJingle
nodes.summary: Plays an ascending piano arpeggio as triumphant feedback on loop quiet or victory.

nodes.name: playDefeatSting
nodes.summary: Plays a descending minor strings pad with a kick thud when the party is silenced.

nodes.name: playQteHit
nodes.summary: Plays rating-dependent lead feedback (double note for perfect/sick, duller tone for bad) on a QTE hit.

nodes.name: playQteMiss
nodes.summary: Plays a low muted snare thud on a QTE miss or parry fumble.

nodes.name: playChordChange
nodes.summary: Plays a shimmering strings-pad strum when a new harmonic chord takes effect.

nodes.name: playUiClick
nodes.summary: Plays a soft tactile hi-hat click for UI button presses.

nodes.name: playDrumHit
nodes.summary: Auditions a single drum voice (kick/snare/hat/perc) for Studio pad taps.

nodes.name: playEnemyTelegraph
nodes.summary: Plays a pattern-specific audio telegraph motif (ostinato, swarm, inversion, erasure, or default) when an enemy gathers an attack.

nodes.name: makeLead
nodes.summary: Builds a pooled PolySynth lead or pad from a voice recipe, routing in parallel to the master bus and a scaled reverb send.

nodes.name: makeBass
nodes.summary: Builds a pooled MonoSynth bass from a recipe with a lowpass filter envelope tuned to the recipe cutoff.

nodes.name: initVoices
nodes.summary: Allocates every instrument's lead/pad/bass plus the shared kick, snare, hat, perc, and reverb exactly once, wiring each into the master bus.

nodes.name: getVoices
nodes.summary: Returns the pooled voices singleton, throwing when initVoices() has not run yet.

nodes.name: instrumentVoices
nodes.summary: Looks up an instrument's pooled voices by id, falling back to the neutral strings voices for unknown or null ids.

nodes.name: applyDrumKit
nodes.summary: Recolors the shared drums to a kit's timbre through live parameter sets only, restoring the neutral pulse on null and skipping redundant applications.

nodes.name: triggerDrums
nodes.summary: Fires one step of drums, expanding each hit's roll into extra evenly spaced sub-hits at reduced velocity while velocity carries accents and ghosts.

nodes.name: hasVoices
nodes.summary: Reports whether the voice pool has been initialized, used to no-op audition keys pressed while halted.

nodes.name: chord-remake.md
nodes.summary: Design brief proposing a rebuild of the note-attack system: map the 7 diatonic chords to QWERTYU with arrow-key chord modifications, add a live chord loop, and record melody notes as chord tones plus tension/color tones.

nodes.name: combat-pacing-plan.md
nodes.summary: Phased redesign plan for combat pacing: engine work (enemy attack cooldowns, intro grace period, enemy and party HP rebalance), rhythm-aware QTE charts derived from melodies and enemy patterns, number-key character selection, and additive suggestions like stagger and dynamic loop length.

nodes.name: mechanics.md

nodes.name: qte-redesign.md
nodes.summary: QTE panel rebuild plan that diagnoses current RAF/state churn jank, surveys FNF/DDR/Guitar Hero conventions, and specifies an always-visible bottom-receptor highway, a single audio-anchored playhead hook, memoized note transforms, and consolidated judgement feedback.

nodes.name: v1-plan.md
nodes.summary: V1 audit that compares the mechanics spec against the actual codebase (matches, mismatches, missing features), criticizes the UI, and lays out a phased roadmap from engine fixes through screen flow, combat UI, missing mechanics, and polish.

nodes.name: .gitattributes

nodes.name: progress.tsx

nodes.name: CardPreviewButton.tsx

nodes.name: CombatFeedback.tsx

nodes.name: CombatFeedback

nodes.name: CombatLog.tsx

nodes.name: CombatLog

nodes.name: CustomChordBuilder.tsx

nodes.name: MetricBar
nodes.summary: Ten-segment readout bar for a 0..100 quality metric, filling segments instead of using an inline width style.

nodes.name: CustomChordBuilder
nodes.summary: Exported builder component managing bar state and an active bar, applying or charting the progression against the session store, and saving named custom presets.

nodes.name: EncounterBanner.tsx
nodes.summary: Encounter stage selector showing the unlocked/cleared state of every trial, prev/next steppers, recommended BPM, and the enemy composition with HP, archetype and weaknesses.

nodes.name: EncounterBanner

nodes.name: PartyCorner.tsx
nodes.summary: Party formation panel with the chord seat, three front-row attacker seats and a scrollable deck; fighter cards move between seats by drag-and-drop.

nodes.name: Card
nodes.summary: Draggable fighter card showing avatar, name, role, trait, HP/shield meters, an optional seat-number badge, active buffs and a take-the-lead button.

nodes.name: PartyCorner
nodes.summary: Exported panel component owning drag-over state and roster-modal state, resolving deck membership via deckIds and committing drops through moveFighter.

nodes.name: FoePanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Enemy roster during combat: one card per foe with avatar, HP/shield meters, ATB strike gauge, archetype, reflect/track-wipe traits, weaknesses, resists and active buffs.

nodes.name: FoePanel

nodes.name: GrooveMatrix.tsx

nodes.name: Sparkline
nodes.summary: Renders 16 tiny ticks giving a clip's velocity shape at a glance, accenting steps that carry a roll.

nodes.name: GrooveMatrix
nodes.summary: Exported matrix component that previews the pending groove over the live one and exposes bank, pad and kit selection to the session store.

nodes.name: GroovePicker.tsx
nodes.summary: Studio drum-rig picker combining the groove matrix with curated ready-made rigs for the active bank, bag toggles, one-loop auditions and a swing-feel slider.

nodes.name: GroovePicker
nodes.summary: Exported picker component that lists rigsForBank(view.bankId), marks equipped/pending/bagged rigs and exposes swing tweaking to the store.

nodes.name: LoadoutBar.tsx
nodes.summary: In-combat card bar listing the grooves and melodies carried into the fight, with queued next-loop swaps and a control to snapshot the live loop into a new custom melody card.

nodes.name: LoadoutBar
nodes.summary: Exported bar that resolves bagged groove/melody ids against the available choices, queues selections, and snapshots the loop into a named custom card.

nodes.name: MelodyCardBar.tsx
nodes.summary: Studio melody-card rack where attackers' templates can be loaded into the grid, bagged for combat, auditioned once, deleted when custom, or saved from the live loop.

nodes.name: MelodyCardBar
nodes.summary: Exported rack component rendering every melody card with active/pending/bagged state and wiring load, preview, bag, delete and save actions to the store.

nodes.name: Meter.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared 0..100 bar meter used for HP, shields, enemy gauges and voice levels, with a caller-supplied bar class and optional overlay children.

nodes.name: Meter
nodes.summary: Exported meter component that fills a rounded track by a percentage width and slots extra children (e.g. a shield overlay) inside the track.

nodes.name: PhaseStrip.tsx
nodes.summary: Chord progression strip that highlights the currently sounding bar from the global step and shows a tier-reactive aura tag with the blessing summary.

nodes.name: QtePanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Rhythm QTE panel rendering the falling-note highway and receptor row for chord swaps, bottled recalls and enemy parries, with judgement popups, combo/accuracy readouts and miss/telegraph SFX.

nodes.name: QtePanel

nodes.name: VoiceBar

nodes.summary: Global keyboard hook translating WASD harmony keys, number keys, and ZXCV parry keys into session store performance actions while ignoring typing and dialog focus.

nodes.name: useWasd
nodes.summary: Registers keydown, keyup, and blur listeners on window, routing presses to performer selection, QTE performance, and parry release, and clearing held keys on blur.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet defining the shadcn light and dark theme tokens, the Tailwind v4 theme bridge, and the combat animation keyframes used by the battle UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Tailwind v4 @theme inline to map raw shadcn CSS variables onto utility color names, plus @custom-variant for dark-mode class scoping.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Shared class name helper that merges conditional clsx input and resolves Tailwind conflicts with twMerge.

nodes.name: cn
nodes.summary: Combines class name inputs with clsx and dedupes conflicting Tailwind utilities via twMerge.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: Browser entry point that mounts the App component into the root element under React StrictMode and loads the global stylesheet.

nodes.name: storage.ts
nodes.summary: localStorage persistence layer with load and save pairs for cleared encounters, party selection, custom chords, tutorial state, equipped groove, groove bottles, and card loadout.
nodes.languageNotes: Every accessor guards on an isStorageAvailable probe and wraps JSON parsing, degrading to defaults rather than throwing in private-mode or server contexts.

nodes.name: loadClearedEncounters
nodes.summary: Reads the persisted list of cleared encounter ids, validating that the stored value is an array before returning it.

nodes.name: saveClearedEncounters
nodes.summary: Serializes the cleared encounter ids to localStorage, no-oping when storage is unavailable.

nodes.name: loadSelectedParty
nodes.summary: Reads the persisted party roster ids, returning an empty selection when nothing valid is stored.

nodes.name: saveSelectedParty
nodes.summary: Persists the chosen party character ids so the formation survives reloads.

nodes.name: loadCustomChords
nodes.summary: Reads user-authored chord presets from localStorage, falling back to an empty list on parse failure.

nodes.name: saveCustomChords
nodes.summary: Writes the custom chord preset list to localStorage.

nodes.name: loadTutorialSeen
nodes.summary: Reports whether the player has already dismissed the tutorial guide, seeding the prep screen modal state.

nodes.name: saveTutorialSeen
nodes.summary: Records that the tutorial has been seen so the guide does not reopen on later visits.

nodes.name: loadEquippedGroove
nodes.summary: Restores the groove rig equipped before the last session ended, returning null when absent.

nodes.name: saveEquippedGroove
nodes.summary: Persists the currently equipped groove rig as JSON.

nodes.name: loadGrooveBottles
nodes.summary: Reads the studio-built groove bottles, validating the stored value is an array.

nodes.name: saveGrooveBottles
nodes.summary: Writes the studio bottle shelf to localStorage.

nodes.name: loadCardLoadout
nodes.summary: Restores the brought-into-fight card loadout of groove and melody cards.

nodes.name: saveCardLoadout
nodes.summary: Persists the chosen card loadout for the next session.

nodes.name: clearAllPersistedData
nodes.summary: Wipes every known persistence key, used when resetting progression entirely.

nodes.name: useSessionStore.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand store that mirrors the non-React engine session into React and exposes every transport, arrangement, loadout, and performance action the screens call.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately thin: rules stay in src/game and sound in src/audio, and this module is the single place configurePlayer() wires the engine to the Tone.js renderer.

nodes.name: haltPlayback
nodes.summary: Tears down anything the transport owns (Tone loop, audition, half-held keys) and resets playback flags, since the repeat lives outside React.

nodes.name: useSessionStore
nodes.summary: Underscore-free Zustand hook holding arrangement, fight, loadout, and cursor state with actions that delegate to the engine session and stop the transport whenever the combat screens are left.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration wiring the React and Tailwind plugins together with the @ path alias pointing at src.
